==About me==

I love disappearing into the world of the Wheel of Time! I'm currently doing a thorough re-read of the series so I'm good and refreshed when the final book comes out. Neglecting my real life responsibilities for reading this series the first time around has caused issues in the past. Hopefully I can plan my wedding, which will be the month following the release of a Memory of Light!

I'm fascinated by the details and concepts surrounding ''[[saidar]]'' and ''[[saidin]]''. However, [[Min]] is my favorite character in the book partially because she cannot channel. Mostly it's because of her sense of irony and silly humor.

==Creation==
I am annoyed at the lack of maps of individual countries because I have a hard time visualizing geography without maps. (Even with the books' maps, I had the location of country [[Arad Doman]] mixed up with the city [[Ebou Dar]] for the longest time, if that gives you an idea of how confused I get.) The big maps of the [[Westlands]]/Randland don't show borders very well and it's hard to get a sense of where cities lay in relation to the borders and each other etc. etc. Plus they're too busy and information dense.
So, I sat down and made a map myself. (Actually, I lounged down with my laptop in my bed.) It took me all day to do [[Altara]]. I've always been iffy on where Salidar is. I now know. :D 
[[image:Large altara map.png]]
I made a separate file for [[Salidar]] and one for Ebou Dar with those particular cities more prominently displayed on the map. I may make more files for more places in Altara. Maybe I'll get inspired to put in another days work for another country some day! Feel free to lavish praise on me for my artwork and hard work!
